entities.summary: Amroha is a city in the state of Uttar Pradesh in India. It is located north-west of Moradabad. It is the administrative headquarters of Amroha district. Amroha is a city in South Asia. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
